components.name: Primary Button (slanted cut)
components.description: The single main action per view; right edge cut at about 60 degrees to echo the A in the logo.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: inline-block; padding: 0.95rem 2rem 0.95rem 1.6rem; font-weight: 500; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: var(--accent-btn, #176ab0); clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, calc(100% - 0.85rem) 100%, 0 100%); transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before { background: var(--accent-btn-hover, #115e9e); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #115e9e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Link Action
components.description: Secondary action paired with the primary button; 2px blue underline.
components.css: .ds-link { font-weight: 500; text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--accent-text, #115e9e); text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-underline-offset: 0.35em; } .ds-link:hover { color: var(--accent-text, #115e9e); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #115e9e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Outlined 2px-radius toggle with a mono count; selected state fills Button Blue.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; background: none; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #7a8796); border-radius: 2px; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--text, #161e27); transition: background 120ms, border-color 120ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-n { font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--text-2, #4b5866); } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--accent-text, #115e9e); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: var(--accent-btn, #176ab0); border-color: var(--accent-btn, #176ab0); color: #fff; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] .ds-chip-n { color: #fff; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #115e9e); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Register Row
components.description: A project as a ruled row: name, summary, mono stack, mono meta column, and a nudging arrow.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #7a8796); } .ds-item { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d3dae2); } .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 11rem 1.5rem; gap: 1rem; padding: 2rem 0.75rem; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: background 120ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--surface, #ebeff3); } .ds-main { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-name { font-size: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-row:hover .ds-name { color: var(--accent-text, #115e9e); } .ds-summary { margin: 0; max-width: 46ch; color: var(--text-2, #4b5866); font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-mono { font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--text-2, #4b5866); line-height: 1.7; } .ds-meta { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; padding-top: 0.5rem; } .ds-arrow { margin-top: 0.4rem; color: var(--text-2, #4b5866); transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), color 240ms; } .ds-row:hover .ds-arrow { transform: translate(2px, -2px); color: var(--accent-text, #115e9e); } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #115e9e); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Browser Frame
components.description: Screenshot in a 6px-radius browser frame with a dotted bar and a mono URL pill; the only elevated element.
components.css: .ds-browser { background: var(--frame, #dfe5eb); border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(22 30 39 / 0.08), 0 18px 40px -18px rgb(22 30 39 / 0.32); overflow: hidden; } .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; height: 2rem; padding-inline: 0.75rem; background: var(--frame-bar, #cfd7e0); } .ds-dots { display: flex; gap: 6px; } .ds-dots i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--line-strong, #7a8796); opacity: 0.55; } .ds-url { flex: 1; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; padding: 2px 0.75rem; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--frame, #dfe5eb); color: var(--text-2, #4b5866); font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.6875rem; } .ds-screen { background: var(--surface, #ebeff3); }

components.name: Phone Frame
components.description: Device Black bezel, 22px radius, screenshot kept at its real 1080:2340 ratio.
components.css: .ds-phone { width: 9rem; padding: 7px; background: #05080c; border-radius: 22px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(22 30 39 / 0.08), 0 18px 40px -18px rgb(22 30 39 / 0.32), inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); } .ds-phone-screen { overflow: hidden; border-radius: 15px; background: #05080c; }

components.name: Carousel Controls
components.description: Square outlined arrows with a mono count, and a thumbnail row where the current one is full opacity with a blue ring.
components.html: 3 of 12
components.css: .ds-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; } .ds-arrow-btn { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; background: none; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #7a8796); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--text, #161e27); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms, color 120ms; } .ds-arrow-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent-text, #115e9e); color: var(--accent-text, #115e9e); } .ds-arrow-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #115e9e); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-count { min-width: 11ch; text-align: center; font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--text-2, #4b5866); } .ds-thumbs { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; margin-top: 1rem; } .ds-thumb { display: block; width: 6rem; height: 3.75rem; background: var(--surface, #ebeff3); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d3dae2); border-radius: 3px; opacity: 0.6; } .ds-thumb[aria-current='true'] { opacity: 1; border-color: var(--accent-text, #115e9e); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--accent-text, #115e9e); }

components.name: Form Field
components.description: Label above, Surface fill, 1px strong border, 2px radius; error is color plus the word Error.
components.html: Enter a complete email address.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; max-width: 24rem; } .ds-field label { font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 0.8rem 1rem; background: var(--surface, #ebeff3); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #7a8796); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--text, #161e27); font: inherit; transition: border-color 120ms, background 120ms; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: var(--text-2, #4b5866); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #115e9e); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--accent-text, #115e9e); } .ds-field input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: var(--error, #b3303a); } .ds-error { display: flex; gap: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; color: var(--error, #b3303a); } .ds-error::before { content: 'Error:'; font-weight: 700; }

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; height: 4rem; padding-inline: 1rem; background: var(--bg, #f4f6f8); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #d3dae2); } .ds-brand { font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--text, #161e27); } .ds-brand span { color: var(--accent-text, #115e9e); } .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2rem; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; padding-block: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.9375rem; text-decoration: none; color: var(--text-2, #4b5866); transition: color 120ms; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--text, #161e27); } .ds-nav a::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; height: 1px; background: var(--accent-text, #115e9e); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-nav a:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-text, #115e9e); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads as a datasheet for a small software company, not a landing page. Work is a ruled register of real projects with specs (type, year, status, stack) and a sticky preview that follows the focused row. Real screenshots lead; the interface recedes behind hairline rules, square corners and one chromatic color taken from the logo.

Neutrals are ink-blue, tinted toward the logo hue, in both a light and a dark theme (system preference, with a user toggle). Blue appears only on actions, links, active states and a rule above each process step. Type is one grotesk for everything and a mono face reserved for data: stacks, years, measurements, counts. Motion is short and functional.

The build refuses the centered hero, card grid and icon-in-circle template. Containers are square; rounding is reserved for inputs, screenshot frames and phone devices, where it describes a real object.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline rules (1px) divide sections, rows and table lines instead of boxes or cards.
One chromatic color (logo blue) with a separate text-safe and button-safe variant per theme.
A 60-degree slanted cut on primary buttons echoes the A in the logo.
Screenshots sit in browser and phone frames; the frame is the only elevated element.
Both themes meet WCAG AA; focus is always visible.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Logo blue is the only chromatic color. Status colors appear only for status.

rules.name: The Text-Safe Rule
rules.body: Blue used as text, outline or underline must be the accent-text variant; blue used as a fill behind white text must be accent-btn. The raw logo blue is for non-text marks.

rules.name: The Data Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Mono type carries only data: stacks, years, measurements, counts, hosts. Never headings, never decoration.

rules.name: The Three Weights Rule
rules.body: 400 reads, 500 acts (links, buttons, labels, lead lines), 700 announces. No other weights are loaded.

rules.name: The Vary the Split Rule
rules.body: Adjacent sections must not repeat the same column composition.

rules.name: The Frames Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft, long, low-opacity, and belong to screenshot frames. Containers, buttons, chips and fields never cast one.

dos: Do separate content with 1px rules (line for rows, line-strong for the top of a list or table) rather than boxes.
Do use accent-btn behind white text and accent-text for blue text; check both themes.
Do use the slanted-cut primary button for the single main action in a view; pair it with a text link, not a second button.
Do set stacks, years, counts and hosts in JetBrains Mono at 0.8125rem with tabular numerals.
Do keep container corners square; use 2px for inputs and chips, 6px for screenshot frames, 22px for phones.
Do show real screenshots inside the browser or phone frame and keep the phone at its true aspect ratio.
Do vary column composition between adjacent sections, and keep body measure to roughly 34 to 52ch.
Do keep a visible 2px Link Blue focus outline on every interactive element, and pair error color with the word "Error:".
donts: Don't build a centered hero, a card grid or icon-in-circle feature blocks.
Don't add a second chromatic color, gradients, or tinted decorative blobs.
Don't cast shadows on anything but screenshot frames.
Don't use mono type for headings or decoration, or set short uppercase labels above headings.
Don't invent metrics, client logos or testimonials; content must trace to a real project.
Don't use raw Logo Blue as text or as a button fill behind white text.
Don't animate layout properties or add motion longer than 240ms to interface states.
